d.x: Kayaking is an Olympic sport.

d.g: To traverse (a body of water) by kayak.
d.x: On a dare, he kayaked the Harlem River in New York from Hell's Gate to Spyten Duyvil.

kayak.e: Borrowed from Inuktitut ᖃᔭᖅ (qayaq, “hunter's boat”) (Inuvialuktun), from Proto-Eskimo *qayaʁ. Compare Greenlandic qajaq and Yup'ik qayaq.

d.g: A knockout.
To knock someone out, or render them unconscious or senseless.

kayo.e: Respelling of the initial letters KO.
